text: Ko onon yo wondiiɓe am ɗiɗo ka kaso! Yi'uɗo e mon on no hama inbu, o yaltay woni ka kaso, o yiltitoo e golle makko, o yarna laamɗo on. Oya yi'uɗo cobbal ngal ka hoore-mun colli no ñaama e maggal, ko wareteeɗo fetee, colli ɗin ñaama teewu hoore makko nden. Fiyaaku mo lanndiɗon fii mun on ñaawaama gasii. Ɗum ko waɗayɗum feere alaa.
